prompt:
Create a high-fidelity OmniGear 'Parâmetros' settings UI design comparison. Use the supplied approved UI image as VISUAL IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY: inherit header, sidebar, typography, monochrome black/white surfaces, thin dividers and restrained spacing. Replace all DPI content with mouse parameter controls. Output ONE square board containing TWO equal full desktop landscape app viewports stacked: DARK above, LIGHT below. Same structure and state in both. No exterior titles or browser frame. Readable Brazilian Portuguese, no tiny crowded labels.
Header 'OmniGear', small 'Demonstração' badge, ONE crescent moon outline icon in dark upper screen and ONE sun outline icon in light lower screen. No theme switch or paired icons. Left sidebar20% width: '← Dispositivos', 'Mouse de demonstração', 'Perfil 1' dropdown, nav 'Botões', 'DPI', 'Desempenho', 'Parâmetros' SELECTED, 'Perfis', 'Geral'. Main heading 'Parâmetros', subtitle 'Ajuste o sensor, os cliques e o repouso.'
Existing supported demo settings only, grouped logically:
SENSOR: 'Sincronização de movimento' ON, short helper 'Alinha a leitura do sensor ao envio de dados.'; 'Correção de linha reta' OFF, helper 'Corrige pequenos desvios na trajetória.'; 'Correção de ondulação' OFF, helper 'Suaviza oscilações em movimentos rápidos.'; 'Altura de rastreio (LOD)' numeric '1,0 mm' with slider; 'Rotação do sensor' numeric '0°' with slider from '-30°' through '0°' to '+30°', thumb centered.
CLIQUES: 'Atraso antirrepique' with selected '4 ms' among options '0 / 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 / 16 ms', helper 'Reduz cliques duplos involuntários.'
ENERGIA: 'Suspensão' selected '5 min' among options '1 / 2 / 5 / 10 / 15 min'; 'Alcance estendido' OFF, helper 'Prioriza a conexão a distâncias maiores.'
Use proper neutral mini switches for boolean SETTINGS; only theme control is icon-only. Include text 'Ativado' or 'Desativado' beside switches when space allows so state isn't color-only. No automatic calibration, firmware, RGB, battery metrics or extra controls.
Footer across main bottom: '1 alteração não salva', secondary 'Descartar', primary 'Salvar no perfil'. Primary white on dark, black on light. Clean utility interface, clear grouping and consistent content across both themes.
OPTION 2: Single broad list table, all eight controls visible without nested cards. Group headings 'Sensor', 'Cliques', 'Energia' are small inline section labels with clear vertical spacing. Sensor has five rows: motion sync, line correction, ripple correction, LOD slider+numeric1,0mm, rotation slider+numeric0°. Cliques one antirrepique row with compact segmented choices right. Energia has suspensão segmented row and Alcance estendido boolean row. Labels LEFT, controls RIGHT in aligned consistent column. Boolean descriptions may be omitted in this compact composition and replaced by subtle information-circle icons, but all exact labels remain readable. Compact rows around40px in each desktop viewport. Thin horizontal separators, airy horizontal spacing. No mouse render, no angle gauge, no additional side inspector. More like a precise settings list than a grid.
title: Lista de ajustes
description: Configurações alinhadas em linhas, no mesmo estilo do DPI escolhido.
notes: Visual proposal. Numeric ranges and positions are illustrative; use actual device capability min/max/step and mathematically correct slider positions in implementation. Settings switches are distinct from the single theme icon. Accordion option exposes collapsed settings on expansion.
